lines.text: With s! Congratulations on your new job!

native.tip: Kata “selamat” tidak punya bentuk jamak. Di bahasa Inggris, ucapan ini selalu pakai s di akhir: congratulations.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Congratulation!” 😅 Ucapan ini selalu pakai s: “Congratulations!” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “Congratulations”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Congratulations!” lalu tulis ucapan selamat untuk seseorang. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: “Selamat” has no plural form. In English, this wish always ends with s: congratulations.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Congratulation!” 😅 This wish always ends with s: “Congratulations!” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
